build_DANN_instance: build a DANN adversarial training algorithm instance with custom MLP output sizes and loss functions
run_DANN_call: run the DANN algorithm to compute standard loss from logits and targets with property values
run_DANN_adversary: run the DANN adversary method to compute adversarial loss and property top-1 accuracy from logits
review_DANN_class: review the DANN class that enforces logits contain no information about sensitive property values
refactor_DANN_adversary: refactor the DANN adversary method to use a different MLP architecture for property estimation
